rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial choice for something being very strong, extreme, or unusually high in degree.

example.jyutping: gam1 jat6 go3 fung1 ging6 daai6

rows.note: Use this when the intensity is a clearly strong sensation, reaction, feeling, or thought rather than just something being generally powerful.

example.jyutping: ni1 zan6 mei6 hou2 koeng4 lit6

rows.note: Use this for intense study or another activity when the person is deeply absorbed and engaged.

example.jyutping: ngo5 wan1 syu1 go2 zan6 hou2 tau4 jap6

rows.note: Use this for the ardent, passionate side of intense feelings, support, or responses.

example.english: The fans gave the team intense support.
example.jyutping: kau4 mai4 bei2 deoi6 bo1 jit6 lit6 zi1 ci4
